displayAddress: St Matthew's Gardens, Cambridge, Cambridge, CB1
description:
Belvoir are pleased to present this property is offered in immaculate condition in the sought-after St Matthew’s Gardens development in central Cambridge, for which an underground parking space is included. With high ceilings throughout and a Juliette balcony in the living area, the accommodation feels bright and generously proportioned. The property has been finished to a high standard and benefits from an EPC rating of C and Council Tax Band C.

St Matthew’s Gardens is well positioned for access to Cambridge city centre, with an extensive range of shops, restaurants, cafés and cultural attractions. Nearby green spaces, including Parker’s Piece, Midsummer Common and the riverside walks along the Cam, provide attractive walking and cycling routes.

The location offers excellent public transport links. Cambridge railway station is within easy reach, providing regular services to London King’s Cross and London Liverpool Street, as well as connections to Ely, Peterborough and Stansted Airport. Local bus routes connect the area with key employment hubs and retail areas across the city.

Cyclists benefit from established cycle routes into the historic core of Cambridge and towards the university colleges and science parks. Everyday amenities, including supermarkets, local shops and cafés, are located within convenient distance, adding to the practicality of this central position.

Overall, this is a well-presented Cambridge property in a highly accessible location, combining modern accommodation, secure underground parking and strong transport connections.
